description: Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so the absence of classified requests leaves demand unknown. The catalogue QA pilot already has a verified live destination and a prepared operator handoff. The next test is whether a buyer can use that destination to prepare a request the private cycle can handle. The test uses fictional data and creates no buyer event. Sending the pilot remains an operator decision. A classified eligible request or a redacted send or decline receipt would change the next step. Treasury reports no verified funding or revenue.
